test_title: PYST 47: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

# : RMN :: TOP : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: # : RMN :: TOP : % 

Option 1) #=MOU, % : YLU → MOU : RMN :: TOP : YLU 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/649b7e277cfec761b599e88e4e73a09d3314bcb8f19698cf1275708a47a11a15.png] 

Option 2) # NHI, % : YOK → NHI : RMN :: TOP : YOK

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b270472fb0f84004481649cce2df2b22ae0861009f357436bc05e161e27564f1.png] 

Option 3) # : KJI, % = YMU → KJI : RMN :: TOP : YMU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/370d3ae0ae5ac0898a9804c1ae1d0330a1b3b1529330abb9512858c3d6049df8.png] 

Option 4) #= MHI, % = YTU → MHI : RMN :: TOP : YTU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44dfffb3e49462cbd7b98e6af7ef3100526ad508b81697d465851d77def0b1a6.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
